title: A few giant papers, most of the citations
body: 160 papers with more than 50 authors (2.1% of output) hold 19% of all citations. Field-weighted impact tells a fairer story.

title: Who is growing fastest
body: IISER TVM grew its affiliated output by 17.2% a year (2016→2025), against 12.3% for the three institutes together.

title: Collaboration follows departments
body: The 26 Leiden communities match departments with NMI 0.62; only 29 of 303 faculty ties cross between the three IISERs.

title: We cite India more than India cites us
body: Citation in/out ratio with other Indian institutes runs from 0.59 (IISER Bhopal) to 0.96 (IISER TVM): 8,413 citations in vs 8,747 out for TVM.

title: New collaborations are predictable
body: Shared co-authors before 2022 predict which faculty pairs start working together later (Adamic–Adar AUC 0.64 on 44 new ties).

title: Three islands of citation
body: 96% of citations between the three IISERs' papers stay inside one institute; a log-normal tail fits better than a power law.
